svg.title: Leadership and impact
svg.desc: Leadership roles: President, Machine Learning @ Illinois Tech: Leads the student ML community: technical workshops, build sessions and public demos such as ConfusionClassifier at the club fair.; President, Illinois Tech Robotics: Previously Treasurer and Instructor. Ran budgets and workshops (AI/ML, Linux, Python) and led an autonomous robot-fleet project.; Autonomous Systems Lead, NASA Lunabotics Team: Leads autonomy software for the team's lunar robotics entry: perception, localization, mapping and planning.; Co-Founder & Chief AI Officer, A Little Tech For You: Technology learning for older adults: an AI-narrated lesson pipeline, plain-language assistance and the model/inference stack.; Sensor Fusion Lead, EcoCAR EV Challenge: Connected & automated vehicle engineer: perception requirements, validation test cases and real-time C++/RTMaps modules.; Leadership Academy Scholar, M.A. & Lila Self Leadership Academy: Selected for leadership development. Built AILA and LEAD-AI as AI tools for the Academy itself. Recognition: WINNER: StarkHacks 2026, Qualcomm Robotics Track (OBSERV-E, team); FEATURED: Illinois Tech story: “Intelligent Systems for Safer Roads”; BADGE: Microsoft Learn AI Skills Fest
